verses.en: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.pt: Digo a verdade em Cristo, não minto, dando testemunho comigo a minha consciência no Espírito Santo,
verses.en_web: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: I say what is true in Christ, and not what is false, my mind giving witness with me in the Holy Spirit,

verses.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.pt: que tenho grande tristeza e incessante dor no meu coração.
verses.en_web: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
verses.en_bbe: That I am full of sorrow and pain without end.

verses.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.pt: Porque eu mesmo desejaria ser separado de Cristo, por amor de meus irmãos, que são meus parentes segundo a carne;
verses.en_web: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh,
verses.en_bbe: For I have a desire to take on myself the curse for my brothers, my family in the flesh:

verses.en: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
verses.pt: os quais são israelitas, de quem é a adoção, e a glória, e os pactos, e a promulgação da lei, e o culto, e as promessas;
verses.en_web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
verses.en_bbe: Who are Israelites: who have the place of sons, and the glory, and the agreements with God, and the giving of the law, and the worship, and the hope offered by God:

verses.en: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.pt: de quem são os patriarcas; e de quem descende o Cristo segundo a carne, o qual é sobre todas as coisas, Deus bendito eternamente. Amém.
verses.en_web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Whose are the fathers, and of whom came Christ in the flesh, who is over all, God, to whom be blessing for ever. So be it.

verses.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.pt: Não que a palavra de Deus haja falhado. Porque nem todos os que são de Israel são israelitas;
verses.en_web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But it is not as if the word of God was without effect. For they are not all Israel, who are of Israel:

verses.en: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.pt: nem por serem descendência de Abraão são todos filhos; mas: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência.
verses.en_web: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
verses.en_bbe: And they are not all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, In Isaac will your seed be named.

verses.en: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.pt: Isto é, não são os filhos da carne que são filhos de Deus; mas os filhos da promessa são contados como descendência.
verses.en_web: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
verses.en_bbe: That is, it is not the children of the flesh, but the children of God's undertaking, who are named as the seed.

verses.en: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.pt: Porque a palavra da promessa é esta: Por este tempo virei, e Sara terá um filho.
verses.en_web: For this is a word of promise, “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
verses.en_bbe: For this is the word of God's undertaking, At this time will I come, and Sarah will have a son.

verses.en: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
verses.pt: E não somente isso, mas também a Rebeca, que havia concebido de um, de Isaque, nosso pai
verses.en_web: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
verses.en_bbe: And not only so, but Rebecca being about to have a child by our father Isaac--

verses.en: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.pt: (pois não tendo os gêmeos ainda nascido, nem tendo praticado bem ou mal, para que o propósito de Deus segundo a eleição permanecesse firme, não por causa das obras, mas por aquele que chama),
verses.en_web: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
verses.en_bbe: Before the children had come into existence, or had done anything good or bad, in order that God's purpose and his selection might be effected, not by works, but by him whose purpose it is,

verses.en: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.pt: foi-lhe dito: O maior servirá o menor.
verses.en_web: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
verses.en_bbe: It was said to her, The older will be the servant of the younger.

verses.en: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.pt: Como está escrito: Amei a Jacó, e aborreci a Esaú.
verses.en_web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
verses.en_bbe: Even as it is said, I had love for Jacob, but for Esau I had hate.

verses.en: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.pt: Que diremos, pois? Há injustiça da parte de Deus? De modo nenhum.
verses.en_web: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
verses.en_bbe: What may we say then? is God not upright? let it not be said.

verses.en: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.pt: Porque diz a Moisés: Terei misericórdia de quem me aprouver ter misericordia, e terei compaixão de quem me aprouver ter compaixão.
verses.en_web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
verses.en_bbe: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and pity on whom I will have pity.

verses.en: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, isto não depende do que quer, nem do que corre, mas de Deus que usa de misericórdia.
verses.en_web: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
verses.en_bbe: So then, it is not by the desire or by the attempt of man, but by the mercy of God.

verses.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.pt: Pois diz a Escritura a Faraó: Para isto mesmo te levantei: para em ti mostrar o meu poder, e para que seja anunciado o meu nome em toda a terra.
verses.en_web: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: For the holy Writings say to Pharaoh, For this same purpose did I put you on high, so that I might make my power seen in you, and that there might be knowledge of my name through all the earth.

verses.en: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.pt: Portanto, tem misericórdia de quem quer, e a quem quer endurece.
verses.en_web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
verses.en_bbe: So then, at his pleasure he has mercy on a man, and at his pleasure he makes the heart hard.

verses.en: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.pt: Dir-me-ás então. Por que se queixa ele ainda? Pois, quem resiste à sua vontade?
verses.en_web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
verses.en_bbe: But you will say to me, Why does he still make us responsible? who is able to go against his purpose?

verses.en: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
verses.pt: Mas, ó homem, quem és tu, que a Deus replicas? Porventura a coisa formada dirá ao que a formou: Por que me fizeste assim?
verses.en_web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
verses.en_bbe: But, O man, who are you, to make answer against God? May the thing which is made say to him who made it, Why did you make me so?

verses.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.pt: Ou não tem o oleiro poder sobre o barro, para da mesma massa fazer um vaso para uso honroso e outro para uso desonroso?
verses.en_web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
verses.en_bbe: Or has not the potter the right to make out of one part of his earth a vessel for honour, and out of another a vessel for shame?

verses.en: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.pt: E que direis, se Deus, querendo mostrar a sua ira, e dar a conhecer o seu poder, suportou com muita paciência os vasos da ira, preparados para a perdição;
verses.en_web: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
verses.en_bbe: What if God, desiring to let his wrath and his power be seen, for a long time put up with the vessels of wrath which were ready for destruction:

verses.en: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.pt: para que também desse a conhecer as riquezas da sua glória nos vasos de misericórdia, que de antemão preparou para a glória,
verses.en_web: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
verses.en_bbe: And to make clear the wealth of his glory to vessels of mercy, which he had before made ready for glory,

verses.en: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.pt: os quais somos nós, a quem também chamou, não só dentre os judeus, mas também dentre os gentios?
verses.en_web: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
verses.en_bbe: Even us, who were marked out by him, not only from the Jews, but from the Gentiles?

verses.en: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.pt: Como diz ele também em Oséias: Chamarei meu povo ao que não era meu povo; e amada à que não era amada.
verses.en_web: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
verses.en_bbe: As he says in Hosea, They will be named my people who were not my people, and she will be loved who was not loved.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.pt: E sucederá que no lugar em que lhes foi dito: Vós não sois meu povo; aí serão chamados filhos do Deus vivo.
verses.en_web: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ There they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
verses.en_bbe: And in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there they will be named the sons of the living God.

verses.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.pt: Também Isaías exclama acerca de Israel: Ainda que o número dos filhos de Israel seja como a areia do mar, o remanescente é que será salvo.
verses.en_web: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
verses.en_bbe: And Isaiah says about Israel, Even if the number of the children of Israel is as the sand of the sea, only a small part will get salvation:

verses.en: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor executará a sua palavra sobre a terra, consumando-a e abreviando-a.
verses.en_web: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will give effect to his word on the earth, putting an end to it and cutting it short.

verses.en: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.pt: E como antes dissera Isaías: Se o Senhor dos Exércitos não nos tivesse deixado descendência, teríamos sido feitos como Sodoma, e seríamos semelhantes a Gomorra.
verses.en_web: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
verses.en_bbe: And, as Isaiah had said before, If the Lord of armies had not given us a seed, we would have been like Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.en: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.pt: Que diremos pois? Que os gentios, que não buscavam a justiça, alcançaram a justiça, mas a justiça que vem da fé.
verses.en_web: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
verses.en_bbe: What then may we say? That the nations who did not go after righteousness have got righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:

verses.en: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.pt: Mas Israel, buscando a lei da justiça, não atingiu esta lei.
verses.en_web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: But Israel, going after a law of righteousness, did not get it.

verses.en: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.pt: Por que? Porque não a buscavam pela fé, mas como que pelas obras; e tropeçaram na pedra de tropeço;
verses.en_web: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
verses.en_bbe: Why? Because they were not searching for it by faith, but by works. They came up against the stone which was in the way;

verses.en: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.pt: como está escrito: Eis que eu ponho em Sião uma pedra de tropeço; e uma rocha de escândalo; e quem nela crer não será confundido.
verses.en_web: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
verses.en_bbe: As it is said, See, I am putting in Zion a stone causing a fall, and a rock in the way: but he who has faith in him will not be put to shame.
